resources.title: Everything You Need to Know About 0.4 in 18 Minutes
resources.creator: Zizaran
resources.noteEs: Zizaran condensa todo el patch 0.4 (Last of the Druids) en 18 minutos: nueva ascendencia Druid, mecánica de liga Fate of the Vaal, ajustes de balance y endgame. Anchor de mechanics-per-league para los players que arrancan PoE 2 cada nueva temporada.
resources.noteEn: Zizaran condenses the entire 0.4 patch (Last of the Druids) into 18 minutes: new Druid ascendancy, Fate of the Vaal league mechanic, balance adjustments, and endgame changes. Anchor for mechanics-per-league for players entering PoE 2 each new season.

resources.title: PoE 2 0.4 — The Most Important Tip for League Start
resources.creator: Lolcohol
resources.noteEs: Lolcohol enfoca un solo punto crítico para el league start de 0.4: cómo aprovechar la nueva mecánica desde el campaña sin desperdiciar runs. Más conciso que el overview de Zizaran, complementario para players que ya leyeron lo principal y quieren la jugada práctica del día 1.
resources.noteEn: Lolcohol focuses on a single critical point for the 0.4 league start: how to leverage the new mechanic from campaign onward without wasting runs. More concise than Zizaran's overview, complementary for players who've read the main coverage and want the practical day-1 play.

resources.title: Druid Is Finally OUT | Path of Exile 2, Patch 0.4 The Last of the Druids Reveal Reaction
resources.creator: Palsteron
resources.noteEs: Palsteron hace una reacción largo (44 minutos) al reveal del 0.4 con análisis en vivo de cada cambio anunciado por GGG. Útil para players que quieren no solo el resumen sino el reasoning editorial — qué buffs/nerfs importan, qué builds se beneficiaron, qué se perdió. Complemento del overview corto de Zizaran.
resources.noteEn: Palsteron does a long-form (44-minute) reaction to the 0.4 reveal with live analysis of each change GGG announced. Useful for players who want not just the summary but editorial reasoning — which buffs/nerfs matter, which builds benefited, what was lost. Complement to Zizaran's short overview.

resources.title: The State of POE 2 after 200h of The Last of the Druids!
resources.creator: P4wnyhof
resources.noteEs: P4wnyhof retrospectiva tras 200h de juego en 0.4: qué funciona, qué no, dónde están los pain points reales del patch ya en operación. Útil como contrapunto a los hot-takes del lanzamiento — la liga vista con perspectiva de unas semanas. Players con tiempo limitado obtienen filtro editorial maduro acá.
resources.noteEn: P4wnyhof retrospective after 200h of 0.4 gameplay: what works, what doesn't, where the real pain points of the patch are once it's been running. Useful as a counterpoint to launch hot-takes — the league seen with weeks of perspective. Time-constrained players get a mature editorial filter here.
